## Verdict: APPROVE with notes (one Suggestion below the critical threshold; all 39 checklist items pass)
The PR is ready to merge: every checklist item and acceptance criterion passed verification, and the only open finding is a Suggestion about type design.
Rule applied: rule 6 — a finding below the threshold remains → APPROVE with notes

## Code Review Findings

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor (1)
<details><summary>1 item</summary>

1. `src/sqllens/agent/factory.py` lines 101-108 (with `src/sqllens/safety/__init__.py` lines 232-241): nothing in the types stops `ResultMaskingRunner` from being placed beneath `RlsGuardRunner`. `_relation_check_executor` only unwraps `RlsGuardRunner`, `ReadOnlyGuardRunner` and `RowCapRunner`, and `ResultMaskingRunner.run_sql` declares `require_base_tables`. If masking were composed beneath RLS, the construction check would accept the masking wrapper's signature and never reach the engine runner, so the relation check would be skipped silently. Only the factory comment and `test_masking_guard_is_outermost` keep masking outermost today, and today's order is correct. (raised by 1/4 agents) — single-source, flagged for extra human scrutiny.

</details>

The column label itself still appears.
- [ ] The built-in entry list is exactly these 31 — complete by construction: `password`, `passwd`, `pwd`, `passcode`, `secret`, `token`, `hash`, `salt`, `pin`, `otp`, `totp`, `mfa`, `credential`, `apikey`, `api key`, `access key`, `private key`, `encryption key`, `signing key`, `auth key`, `recovery key`, `master key`, `session key`, `one time code`, `verification code`, `reset code`, `recovery code`, `security code`, `auth code`, `sms code`, `backup code`.

Tell the user these values are hidden; do not try to retrieve them with another query.`, with `<labels>` the masked labels joined by `, `. - [ ] The system prompt's "Data Confidentiality" section contains the line `- Select only the columns the question needs. Do not use SELECT * on data tables, and do not select columns that hold secrets, such as passwords, password hashes, tokens, PINs, keys or one-time codes.`

- [ ] Masking applies in all four combinations of `database.read_only` (true or false) and `[[rls]]` (rules present or absent), and for answers produced by the `verify-memory` command.
- [ ] With `[[rls]]` rules configured, the agent still builds, and the RLS relation check still runs on the engine runner.
